coordinate_system_policy: Every real record must declare datum, coordinate system and units. None are declared because no source has passed the gate.

inventory_slots.label: Large pyramid complexes — ordinary records, no core status
targets_to_seek: large pyramid complexes and their immediate substructures
inventory_slots.known_gap: No datum-controlled geometry, coordinates, elevations or sources attached
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: datum-controlled archaeological survey with phase and preservation state

inventory_slots.label: Small, satellite and unfinished pyramids
inventory_slots.known_gap: No complete inventory of small and unfinished pyramids
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: datum-controlled archaeological inventory with construction phase

inventory_slots.label: Mastabas and necropolis fields
inventory_slots.known_gap: Necropolis fields are not enumerated; burial density and extent unknown
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: systematic cemetery survey with mapped graves and detection limits

inventory_slots.label: Mortuary temples and valley temples
inventory_slots.known_gap: No temple inventory or adaptation history attached
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: datum-controlled architectural survey with modification record

inventory_slots.label: Platforms, enclosures and walls
inventory_slots.known_gap: No enclosure or wall network mapped

inventory_slots.label: Sphinx and associated temple complex — ordinary records, no core status
inventory_slots.known_gap: No verified geometry, parent-rock relation or original form claim attached
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: datum-controlled survey distinguishing carved massif from later form

inventory_slots.label: Causeways, roads, ramps, embankments and passages
inventory_slots.known_gap: Linear connectivity not mapped; buried and truncated segments unaccounted
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: connected linear-feature survey with endpoints, gradients and burial state

inventory_slots.label: Boat pits, shafts, wells, chambers and galleries
inventory_slots.known_gap: No explicit cavity inventory; cavities are not inferred from external shape
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: subsurface imaging with datum and confidence map

inventory_slots.label: Quarries, stone-working areas, settlements and storage zones
inventory_slots.known_gap: No complete production and logistics landscape inventory
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: settlement and quarry survey with material-flow and phase evidence

inventory_slots.label: Ancient channels, waterways and hydrogeological structures
inventory_slots.known_gap: Water table, palaeo-flow paths and aquifer properties unresolved
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: hydrogeological survey with datum-controlled heads and permeability

inventory_slots.label: Bedrock massifs, escarpments, fractures and faults
inventory_slots.known_gap: No geological surface or subsurface model and no structural network attached
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: geological map with stratigraphy, structure and datum

inventory_slots.label: Relief, wind, thermal gradients and atmospheric or ground processes
inventory_slots.known_gap: No measured forcing fields or long-baseline environmental records
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: co-located calibrated atmospheric, thermal and ground-process monitoring

inventory_slots.label: Destroyed, buried, partially preserved and currently ambiguous objects
inventory_slots.known_gap: Detection limits unstated; unknown unknowns are not countable
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: systematic survey with explicit detection limits and negative evidence

inventory_slots.label: Interfaces and boundaries between subsystems
inventory_slots.known_gap: No measured contact, boundary or transfer interface attached
inventory_slots.required_survey_layer: source-path-interface-receiver measurement with closed transfer budget

record_field_contract.rule: No field may be populated by assumption; missing values stay null or unknown.

numeric.rule: All required fields present from a verified source; numeric analysis permitted.

interval.rule: Partial verified data expressed as explicit bounds; interval analysis only.

symbolic.rule: No verified data; representation stays symbolic and unresolved.
